name: @aiti-ai/dsh-secret-mask
description: Paste-safe by default — session-level secret redaction for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): values pasted into prompts become opaque rsec_<hash8> tokens before a step enters the model and are restored inside whitelisted tool arguments before execution; unresolved tokens are guarded; tool results are redacted at tools/post-execute and an opt-in llm/stream audit proves no raw value reaches the provider. Detection/placeholder engine shared with the pi editions via @aiti-ai/secret-mask-core.
